messages:
maya: Heads up — release pipeline is blocked by a weird typegen change. Our sampleapp SDK tests started failing after the latest typegen run (PR #4128). CI shows semver bumps in generated types even though no public surface changed.

sam: Ugh. Where's the diff?

maya: pastebin: https://p.rw/diff4128 (short) — main change is that `AuthRetryOptions` went from `retry?: boolean` to `retry: boolean | 'legacy'` (why??). Typegen output claims it's a minor bump but it breaks TS consumers.

lee: CI output:
```
> sample-app-tests
Error: Type 'boolean | "legacy"' is not assignable to type 'boolean'.
  55 | const opts: AuthRetryOptions = { retry: true }
  56 | // from generated types
```
Job: https://ci.redwood/proj/8432/finished

jordan: That change came from the openapi -> typegen mapping for the `x-auth-retry` vendor extension. I rebased and must've picked up a stray spec commit. Sorry.

maya: No worries — but we need a plan: release is pinned to today. If typegen keeps flipping semver we can't ship.

sam: Temporary mitigation: pin SDK generator to v1.9.2 in the pipeline, revert the generated types in the SDK package, and open a fix PR to spec. Then run a regen in a controlled PR.

lee: Agreed. Also we should add a semver-guard check to the CI that fails the pipeline if generated files bump major/minor unexpectedly for patch PRs.

ci-bot: build #8432 failed — tests: sample-app (auth) failed — see: https://ci.redwood/proj/8432/steps/7 :x:

jordan: I'll open two PRs: 1) revert the generated types in sdk-js (hotfix) 2) spec cleanup to make `x-auth-retry` consistent.

maya: Can you also add a one-liner in the release notes and tag the release as "postpone" if hotfix not merged by 10:30 PT? We don't want a half-broken SDK in the release.

jordan: Yep. I'll also add a pre-release hook that runs `yarn typegen:diff` and fails on unexpected semver changes.

sam: For long-term: add a devex test that runs sampleapp with the generated SDK in a matrix against a known-good spec snapshot. That would catch this earlier.

lee: re: changelogs — the typegen step is currently producing an autogenerated changelog entry with the minor bump. We should stop auto-changelog creation for generated artifacts until we prove the mapping. Otherwise it pollutes release notes.

maya: OK. Action items: jordan: hotfix + spec PR, sam: pipeline pin & semver-guard proposal, lee: stop auto changelog for generated packages (temporary). I'll coordinate release timing.

sam: tagging folks on the PR: @jordan @lee @maya.

maya: thanks. If anyone sees other failing samples, drop them here. :thumbsup:
